$comment: Components that requirements define but Forma does not implement yet. They have no catalog page, because documenting them would describe markup that does not exist. When one is implemented it moves to catalog/components/<slug>.mjs and leaves this list. Sources: requirements/COMPONENT-CATALOG.md unless noted. Generated into docs/COMPONENT-INVENTORY.md by tools/catalog/inventory.mjs.

planned.name: Breadcrumbs
planned.note: Record header and scope trail carry breadcrumb-like navigation today; no standalone styled pattern.

planned.name: Application shell
planned.note: workspace-shell and navigation-shell cover the regions; .ef-app-shell is not implemented.

planned.name: Data table styling
planned.note: Plain <table> has no Forma styling outside dense-ledger, data-grid and character-grid.

planned.name: Tag / chip
planned.note: badge and status-lozenge cover static labels; no removable or selectable chip.

planned.name: Icon and icon button
planned.note: Icon-only buttons are composed from button + visually-hidden text today.

planned.name: Button variants (primary, destructive) and async action button
planned.note: Application-layer buttons have one visual style; data-ef-variant="primary" exists only inside the marketing .ef-site scope.

planned.name: Inline message
planned.note: validation-message and alert cover most uses.

planned.name: Field invalid, disabled and read-only styling
planned.note: Native inputs, textareas and selects have no Forma styling for :disabled, :read-only, [aria-invalid] or :user-invalid (src/styles/foundations.css). Found while documenting text-field.

planned.name: Settings list row
planned.note: The Mobile settings composition uses plain links for navigation rows. Evidence for a reusable row primitive; not yet a requirement.

planned.name: Date picker and time picker
planned.requirement: requirements/COMPONENT-CATALOG.md §2 Date picker, Time and date-time
planned.note: date-time-field and date-range use native inputs and pickers.

planned.name: Toolbar
planned.note: command-group and collection-toolbar cover grouped commands.

planned.name: Drawer / sheet (nonmodal, bottom)
planned.note: flyout is the modal left/right baseline.

planned.name: Filter, sort and query builders; bulk action bar; list and virtual list
Meter, copyable field, expandable text, relative time
Tag / token input and color picker
Tree navigation and tree grid
planned.note: hierarchy-tree uses native nesting and disclosure.

planned.name: Editable data grid, transfer list, editable key/value collection, dockable panels
Visualization primitives and chart accessibility contract
